left.heading: DSC
left.alt: Wiring diagram: DSC panel keypad bus to G16. RED to +DC (+12V), BLK to -DC, YEL to CLK, GRN to DATA. G16 I/O 1-3, COM, A 485, B 485 are not connected.

right.heading: PARADOX
right.alt: Wiring diagram: PARADOX panel serial port to G16 through the EX-CRP2.4 cable (ordered separately). R (red) to +DC (+12V), B (black) to -DC, Y (yellow) to CLK, G (green) to DATA. G16 I/O 1-3, COM, A 485, B 485 are not connected.

left.heading: CADDX
left.alt: Wiring diagram: CADDX panel keypad bus to G16. POS to +DC (+12V), COM to -DC, DATA to DATA; CLK is not used.

right.heading: TEXECOM
right.alt: Wiring diagram: TEXECOM panel serial port to G16 through the EX-CRP4 cable (ordered separately). R (red) to +DC (+12V), B (black) to -DC, BL (blue) to CLK, W (white) to DATA.

left.heading: INNERRANGE INCEPTION
left.alt: Wiring diagram: Inner Range Inception to G16. VOUT + (+12V) to +DC and VOUT 0V to -DC; from the panel's USB port through Inner Range cable 993030USB: black wire to the 0V/-DC line, green wire to CLK, white wire to DATA.

right.heading: INNERRANGE INTEGRITI
right.alt: Wiring diagram: Inner Range Integriti Port 0 to G16 through Inner Range cable INTG-996795. +DET (+13V) to +DC, GND 5 to -DC, Rx 3 to CLK, Tx 2 to DATA.

left.heading: Crow Runner 4/8, Runner 8/16
left.alt: Wiring diagram: Crow Runner 4/8, Runner 8/16 panel keypad bus to G16. POS to +DC (+12V), NEG to -DC, CLK to CLK, DATA to DATA.

right.heading: Pyronix
right.alt: Wiring diagram: Pyronix panel keypad bus to G16. +AUX to +DC (+12V), -AUX to -DC, KD to DATA; CLK is not used.

parts.heading: Normally open (NO)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic: normally open (NO) contact between COM and INx. Short - Alarm, Open - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally closed (NC)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic: normally closed (NC) contact between COM and INx. Short - Restore, Open - Alarm.

parts.heading: Normally closed with 2,2k end-of-line resistor (EOL 2,2k)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic: NC contact with a 2,2k end of line resistor in series between COM and INx (EOL 2,2k). Short - Alarm, Open - Alarm, 2,2k - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally open with 2,2k end-of-line resistor (EOL 2,2k)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic: NO contact with a 2,2k end of line resistor in parallel between COM and INx (EOL 2,2k). Short - Alarm, Open - Alarm, 2,2k - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally open with 2,2k end-of-line resistor and tamper recognition (DEOL)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic with tamper recognition (DEOL): between COM and INx, a tamper switch and a 2,2k resistor in series, then the NO contact with a second 2,2k resistor across it. Short - Tamper, Open - Tamper, 2,2k - Alarm, 3,3k-5,5k - Restore.

parts.heading: Normally closed with 2,2k end-of-line resistor and tamper recognition (DEOL)
parts.alt: Input wiring schematic with tamper recognition (DEOL): between COM and INx, a tamper switch and a 2,2k resistor in series, then the NC contact with a second 2,2k resistor across it. Short - Tamper, Open - Tamper, 2,2k - Restore, 3,3k-5,5k - Alarm.
